'''Feral Scar Vale''' is a subarea in [[Feralas]]. It is a cave that houses several [[yeti]].  In the back of the cave is a trapped mechanical chicken by the name of [[Homing Robot OOX-22/FE]].  If you find its distress beacon, then go to Feral Scar Vale and activate the chicken, it will begin an escort quest.

This area consists of three things:
* An entrance cave
* A valley
* A tunnel system
